text:
Tool: workspace_list
Purpose: List files and directories in the project currently open in FrustIDE.
When to use: Use before assuming the project layout or choosing a file to inspect.
Minimum access: OBSERVE.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"limit":{"default":200,"maximum":1000,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"},"path":{"default":".","description":"Path relative to the open project.","type":"string"},"recursive":{"default":false,"type":"boolean"}},"type":"object"}
title: Use workspace_list

text:
Tool: workspace_read
Purpose: Read a UTF-8 project file with line numbers and optional line bounds.
When to use: Read specifications and surrounding source before proposing or making an edit.
Minimum access: OBSERVE.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"end_line":{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"},"path":{"description":"Path relative to the open project.","type":"string"},"start_line":{"default":1,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}},"required":["path"],"type":"object"}
title: Use workspace_read

text:
Tool: workspace_search
Purpose: Search UTF-8 text files in the open project and return matching paths, lines, and excerpts.
When to use: Use to find definitions, references, requirements, and relevant documentation before editing.
Minimum access: OBSERVE.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"file_pattern":{"default":"*","type":"string"},"limit":{"default":50,"maximum":200,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"},"path":{"default":".","description":"Path relative to the open project.","type":"string"},"query":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}},"required":["query"],"type":"object"}
title: Use workspace_search

text:
Tool: workspace_create_directory
Purpose: Create a directory inside the project currently open in FrustIDE, including missing parents.
When to use: Use to establish a requested project or module layout. It succeeds when the directory already exists.
Minimum access: WORKSPACE.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"path":{"description":"Path relative to the open project.","type":"string"}},"required":["path"],"type":"object"}
title: Use workspace_create_directory

text:
Tool: workspace_create_file
Purpose: Create a new UTF-8 source, specification, or documentation file without overwriting an existing file.
When to use: Use for new files. If the file exists, read it and make a focused edit instead.
Minimum access: WORKSPACE.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"content":{"type":"string"},"path":{"description":"Path relative to the open project.","type":"string"}},"required":["path","content"],"type":"object"}
title: Use workspace_create_file

text:
Tool: workspace_replace_text
Purpose: Replace exact text in an existing UTF-8 project file.
When to use: Use for focused edits after reading the file. By default the old text must occur exactly once.
Minimum access: WORKSPACE.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"new_text":{"type":"string"},"old_text":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"path":{"description":"Path relative to the open project.","type":"string"},"replace_all":{"default":false,"type":"boolean"}},"required":["path","old_text","new_text"],"type":"object"}
title: Use workspace_replace_text

text:
Tool: workspace_check_frust
Purpose: Compile-check a Frust source file directly from project content and return structured compiler diagnostics without creating temporary files.
When to use: Use after editing Frust code. Fix reported errors and repeat until the check passes before completing the task.
Minimum access: OBSERVE.
Arguments schema: {"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"path":{"description":"Frust source path relative to the open project.","type":"string"}},"required":["path"],"type":"object"}
title: Use workspace_check_frust
